newsitem.title: ETHIOPIA: Six Ethiopian girls commit suicide over marriages.
newsitem.headline: Six Ethiopian girls commit suicide over marriages.

text.p: Six teenage Ethiopian girls committed suicide to escape traditional marriages to elderly cousins, the state Ethiopian News Agency said on Monday.

It quoted officials of the northeast Afar region as saying that the girls killed themselves over the last nine months rather than marry their cousins. They shot, drowned or hanged themselves, the agency said.

It said traditional marriage in the Afar ethnic community known as "abusuma" forced teenage girls to marry cousins as old as 80. It said officials were trying to curb such marriages, adding that they were tantamount to slavery.
